name: Algorithm 13 Code
definition: Cryptographic algorithms for the protection of transported keys.

EA2C.name: AES 128 CBC
EA2C.definition: AES (Advanced Encryption Standard) CBC (Chaining Block Cypher) encryption with a 128 bits cryptographic key as defined by the Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS 197 - November 6, 2001 - Advanced Encryption Standard).

E3DC.name: DES 112 CBC
E3DC.definition: Triple DES (Data Encryption Standard) CBC (Chaining Block Cypher) encryption with double length key (112 Bit) as defined in FIPS PUB 46-3 - (ASN.1 Object Identifier: des-ede3-cbc).

DKP9.name: DUKPT 2009
DKP9.definition: DUKPT (Derived Unique Key Per Transaction) algorithm, as specified in ANSI X9.24-2009 Annex A.

UKPT.name: UKPT
UKPT.definition: UKPT (Unique Key Per Transaction) or Master Session Key key encryption - (ASN.1 Object Identifier: id-ukpt-wrap).

UKA1.name: UKP Twith AES 128
UKA1.definition: UKPT (Unique Key Per Transaction) or Master Session Key key encryption, using Advanced Encryption Standard with a 128 bits cryptographic key, approved by the Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS 197 - November 6, 2001 - Advanced Encryption Standard).

EA9C.name: AES 192 CBC
EA9C.definition: AES (Advanced Encryption Standard) CBC (Chaining Block Cypher) encryption with a 192 bits cryptographic key as defined by the Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS 197 – November 6, 2001 - Advanced Encryption Standard).

EA5C.name: AES 256 CBC
EA5C.definition: AES (Advanced Encryption Standard) CBC (Chaining Block Cypher) encryption with a 256 bits cryptographic key as defined by the Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS 197 – November 6, 2001 - Advanced Encryption Standard).
